entries.reason: A version of Brick Road that can’t be recycled. The game files mark it for version 32, the version that brings Oona’s update (reported live on 19 November 2026); whether players can get it is not confirmed yet. The version 32 game files will tell.
A tournament season in the game files that hasn’t been seen in game. Greek is the season added in version 31; Rural, Nordic and Mesoamerican have run.
